tagline.en: Pittsburgh's Parkway, stretched to reach the airport
tagline.zh: 匹兹堡的「大道」：为通机场而拉长

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

start.zh: 默瑟县赫米蒂奇附近，与 I-80 相接

end.en: I-76, the Pennsylvania Turnpike, at Monroeville
end.zh: 门罗维尔，与宾州收费高速 I-76 相接

en: I-376 is signed east–west but runs north–south for most of its length, which tells you it was assembled rather than designed. Through Allegheny County it is the Penn-Lincoln Parkway — Parkway West from the airport into town, Parkway East out to Monroeville — and north of there it is the Southern Expressway and the Beaver Valley Expressway, a tolled road built in the early 1990s and still signed 'Toll I-376'. At 84.66 miles it is the second-longest three-digit Interstate in Pennsylvania after I-476.

The odd hundreds digit says spur, and that is roughly what it is: it meets its parent I-76 at Monroeville at the eastern end, crosses it again at Big Beaver in the north-west, and finishes on I-80 rather than looping back. The parts everyone in Pittsburgh knows are the two tunnels: the Squirrel Hill Tunnel on the way in from the east, and the Fort Pitt Tunnel, which delivers westbound drivers out of a hillside directly onto a bridge facing downtown.
zh: I-376 标示为东西向，但大半里程其实是南北走向——这说明它是拼起来的，不是设计出来的。在阿勒格尼县境内它是宾－林肯大道：西段自机场进城，东段通往门罗维尔；再往北则是南方快速路与比弗谷快速路，后者建于 1990 年代初，是收费路段，至今仍标示为「Toll I-376」。全长 84.66 英里，是宾夕法尼亚州仅次于 I-476 的第二长三位数州际公路。
奇数百位意味着支线，大体也确实如此：它在东端的门罗维尔与母线 I-76 相接，在西北的大比弗再次与之交叉，最后止于 I-80 而不是折回。匹兹堡人最熟的两处是隧道：自东进城的松鼠山隧道，以及把西行司机从山腹直接送上一座正对市中心的大桥的皮特堡隧道。

en: The Parkway was a 1940s project. Work on the Squirrel Hill Tunnel began in the mid-1940s and it opened on 5 June 1953 — 4,225 feet of twin bore at a cost of $18 million, at the time the most expensive single project the state highways department had built, and the piece that completed the first eight-mile section of the Parkway. The downtown sections opened between 1956 and 1959, by which point the Parkway had cost $112.11 million. The $6.31 million Fort Pitt Bridge followed on 19 June 1959 and the $16 million Fort Pitt Tunnel on 1 September 1960, completing the route from Monroeville to the airport. The tunnel had been conceived as a toll facility; the governor made a point at the opening of saying it was free.

The number came later and then grew. I-376 was first applied in 1972 to the Pittsburgh–Monroeville section. In 2005 Congress wrote an extension into the SAFETEA-LU transportation act, running I-376 past I-79 and along US 22/US 30 and PA 60 through Pittsburgh International Airport and north to I-80, because the airport was one of the few major airports in the country without direct Interstate access. The signing work, funded partly by the 2009 stimulus act, was done between June 2009 and August 2010. Almost nothing new was built: it was a renaming, which confused drivers who had expected a road.
zh: 这条「大道」是 1940 年代的工程。松鼠山隧道于 1940 年代中期开工，1953 年 6 月 5 日通车——双洞、长 4,225 英尺、造价 1,800 万美元，在当时是州公路部门建过的最贵单项工程，也是让「大道」头八英里得以贯通的那一块。市中心各段在 1956 至 1959 年间陆续通车，届时「大道」已花去 1.1211 亿美元。造价 631 万美元的皮特堡大桥于 1959 年 6 月 19 日通车，造价 1,600 万美元的皮特堡隧道于 1960 年 9 月 1 日通车，使门罗维尔至机场的路线贯通。这座隧道原本设想为收费设施；州长在通车时特意强调它是免费的。

编号来得更晚，之后又变长。I-376 于 1972 年首次用于匹兹堡至门罗维尔段。2005 年，国会把一项延伸写进《SAFETEA-LU》交通法案，让 I-376 越过 I-79，沿 US 22／US 30 与 PA 60 经匹兹堡国际机场北上至 I-80，理由是该机场是全美少数没有州际公路直达的大型机场之一。换标志的工作部分由 2009 年的经济刺激法案出资，在 2009 年 6 月至 2010 年 8 月间完成。几乎没有新建任何东西：这只是改名，却让以为会有新路的司机一头雾水。

timeline.en: The Squirrel Hill Tunnel opens, completing the first eight miles of the Parkway.
timeline.zh: 松鼠山隧道通车，「大道」头八英里贯通。

timeline.en: The Fort Pitt Tunnel opens toll-free, linking Monroeville to the airport.
timeline.zh: 皮特堡隧道免费通车，把门罗维尔与机场连起来。

timeline.en: The I-376 number is first applied, between Pittsburgh and Monroeville.
timeline.zh: I-376 编号首次启用，用于匹兹堡至门罗维尔段。

timeline.en: Congress writes the extension to the airport and I-80 into federal transport law.
timeline.zh: 国会把通往机场与 I-80 的延伸写入联邦交通法案。

timeline.en: Signing of the extended route is completed in August.
timeline.zh: 延伸路段的标志更换于 8 月完成。
